stub_note: written before any forward pass; results overwrite this file carrying declared_at

rules.space: plane, circle, angles and tangents are fitted on the raw type means R_L with coordinate 1038 dropped (prereg R10); the tangent is re-embedded into 1152 dims with 0.0 at that index before steering, which preserves its norm
rules.intervention: h <- h + eps*||h||*t_hat_i at resid_post of layer L, at the member token's own position; ||h|| is per prompt row
rules.orientation: theta, the cyclic order and t_hat all come from ONE PCA basis; t_hat_i = -sin(theta_i) u1 + cos(theta_i) u2 points toward increasing theta, i.e. toward the angular successor; asserted equal to the radial direction rotated +90 degrees
rules.statistic: PRIMARY Delta_i = [logit(succ)-logit(pred)]_steered - the same quantity unsteered, averaged over that member's prompts. The baseline subtraction is a declared reading of prereg 2.6's 'logit(successor) - logit(predecessor)': without it the statistic is dominated by the standing logit asymmetry between two arbitrary vocabulary items. The raw steered value is stored as delta_raw.

arms.natural: 40 contexts of 8 cached tokens ending with the member token (rig.sample_contexts, seed 4700)
arms.bos_only: BOS + member token alone, one deduped row per member

nulls.i: 5 random unit directions per member, orthogonalised against that member's tangent, in full 1152-dim space, at eps=0.02 (seed 4701)
nulls.ii: the tangent rotated +90 and -90 degrees in plane (inward / outward radial), at eps=0.02
nulls.iii: 20 random k-sets drawn from the 3795-type pool, each fitted with its own plane, circle, angular order and tangents and scored by the identical pipeline, at eps=0.02 (seed 4702)

rules.null_prompts: nulls use 12 prompts per member; the candidate's matched comparison value is its mean Delta at eps=0.02 on the natural arm's full 40 prompts
rules.PASS: sign_consistency >= (k-1)/k at SOME eps in the grid (natural arm) AND mean Delta at eps=0.02 above the 99th percentile of null (iii)'s set means AND above ALL 5 of null (i)'s direction means
rules.secondary: in-set softmax readout (p(succ), p(pred), in-set mass) replaces the prereg's route_intermediate_mass, which is defined for multi-step A->B arcs; the i->successor step has no intermediate members by construction. Monotonicity of mean Delta across the eps grid is reported as declared.
rules.positive_control: strict-12 at L6 must PASS this tier's own criterion. The 1.52-vs-0.45 neighbour lift of results/steering_probe.json is L9 month-recall prompts under a different statistic and is cited as context, not as a gate.

deviations_from_prereg: route_intermediate_mass replaced by the in-set softmax readout (see secondary)
no script-48 passer is included: 48 was still running when 47 launched

null (i) uses 5 random directions per member, not the prereg's 20, and nulls run 12 prompts per member rather than the candidate arm's 40: this machine holds ~21 GB wired by an unrelated process and the measured throughput was 13 forwards/s. Null (iii) -- the null the PASS rule actually gates on -- is NOT reduced and runs the prereg's 20 sets. The shorter null prompt budget makes null (iii)'s p99 noisier and therefore HARDER to clear; the candidate's own value on the matched 12-prompt budget is stored as matched_budget_at_eps_null.
